title: Philosophy of Language
modules: Lexical And Grammatical Dimensions Of Meaning
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conglomeration of two Greek words, 'philos' meaning love and 'sophia' meaning wisdom."
Philosophy is a conglomeration of two Greek words, 'philos' meaning love and 'sophia' meaning wisdom.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a metalinguistic relation between two propositions p and q: q logically follows from p (i.e. p implies q), if every semantic interpretation that makes p true automatically makes q true."

A logical implication is a metalinguistic relation between two propositions p and q: q logically follows from p (i.e. p implies q), if every semantic interpretation that makes p true automatically makes q true.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that by uttering the sentence we make certain sounds."
Utterance as a phonetic act means that by uttering the sentence we make certain sounds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any relation between lexical units within the semantic system of a language."
Sense relation is any relation between lexical units within the semantic system of a language.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a genre of deliberate and overt suggestion, one by means of which speakers commit themselves to, implicitly vouch for the truth of, the things they suggest."
Metaphor is a genre of deliberate and overt suggestion, one by means of which speakers commit themselves to, implicitly vouch for the truth of, the things they suggest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the theory of interpretation and it has its unique understanding of meaning."
Hermeneutics is the theory of interpretation and it has its unique understanding of meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the semantic relation between two words that have the same (or nearly the same) meaning."
Synonymy is the semantic relation between two words that have the same (or nearly the same) meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the direct or dictionary meaning of a word, in contrast to its figurative or associated meanings (connotations)."
Denotation refers to the direct or dictionary meaning of a word, in contrast to its figurative or associated meanings (connotations).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the emotional and imaginative association surrounding a word."
Connotation is the emotional and imaginative association surrounding a word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to an object in different ways, a person may also have different sorts of presentations of an object."
Just as one may refer to an object in different ways, a person may also have different sorts of presentations of an object.
